name: Page header
title: Page header
summary: The page's one h1 in a header landmark, with a named trail whose last step is not a link.
description: The top of an inside page, with the one h1 on it.
how: A header landmark holding the page's single h1, with the trail as its own named nav and the current page as a non-link last step carrying aria-current.

name: Split feature
title: Split feature
summary: Words beside a picture, with the words first in the source whichever side the picture is on.
description: A feature block that cannot be read back to front.
how: Only the grid column changes when the picture swaps sides — the words stay first in the source, because swapping with order or row-reverse is how a page ends up read back to front.

name: Stat comparison
title: Stat comparison
summary: Two options compared row by row, with the better one said in words and rows allowed to have no winner.
description: A comparison that says on what terms.
how: Which one is better is said in words as well as shaded, and a row may be marked as neither — pretending every measure has a winner is the commonest dishonesty in this pattern.
